examples.trans: Senya, go work in the kitchen right now!

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (root 'ошться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to everyone'.

examples.text: Так, быстро разошлись все по местам!
examples.trans: All right, everyone disperse to your stations quickly!

examples.text: Во сне играла какая-то странная музыка.
examples.trans: Some strange music was playing in the dream.

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'along' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

examples.text: И только по вкусу выбираю.
examples.trans: And I choose only by taste.

examples.text: Я по запаху твои блюда узнаю.
examples.trans: I will recognize your dishes by their smell.

examples.text: Так, быстро разошлись все по местам!
examples.trans: All right, everyone disperse to your stations quickly!

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'place', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: И место шеф-повара лучшего ресторана.
examples.trans: And the head chef spot at the best restaurant.

examples.text: Так, быстро разошлись все по местам!

examples.text: На второй тур больше мест нет.
examples.trans: There are no more spots for the second round.
